inspection.decision: Retain checked-plan realization as a useful development direction. Before increasing optimization, freeze a separate-context pack with atomic coverage and source/absence audits, inspect upstream planner errors independently where possible, and compare base versus this adapter with identical plans. Do not automatically repeat short fits or queue a sweep.
